messages:
maya: Heads-up: scheduling a rolling maintenance window in eu-central to address intermittent thermal backpressure on racks. Target start: 2026-04-02 01:00 UTC. ETA ~3.5h for the whole cohort.
ops-bot: Maintenance created: ID mnt-euc3-20260402. Notifying affected customers (low-traffic window).
raj: Can we do a soft drain first and observe queue depth? Last time a hard drain spiked tail latency.
sophie: +1 to soft drains. Plan suggestion: 10% cohort canary, 30m observation, then stagger 20% every 25m. Keep KV cache seeding running.
maya: Plan: canary on pool-euc3-saturn (6 nodes) -> if p50 stays <80ms and p99 <900ms we proceed. Soft drain command: ``kubectl cordon node/<node> && ./evacuate --mode=soft --drain-delay=30s``.
raj: Network note: one ToR showing queue hysteresis under sustained bursts. We'll shift egress to us-west fallback for canary if we see egress queue >85%. Monitoring alert: `egress_queue > 85% for 120s`.
oncall-jamie: I'll be oncall for the window. If fallback to us-west happens, I need runbook step to re-route ingress LB and verify cross-region latency to API consumers.
maya: Runbook excerpt for fallback (short):
```
1. set routing policy: region_preference = us-west
2. promote model-variant: m-small-usw for latency-critical routes
3. kick kv-cache rewarm: /ops/kv_seed --pools euc3
4. monitor: p99_gen, egress_queue, capacity_util
```
leo: Cost aside — promoting reserved us-west capacity will add burst billing. Estimate +$4k for 3h if fallback engaged. Flagging finance.
sophie: Also throttles: we'll reduce batch size on affected nodes (`BATCH_MAX_TOKENS=512 -> 256`) to avoid thermal spike during warm-up.
raj: Can we schedule a quick perf test 30m before start to baseline? I can run `abtest --seqlen 512 --qps 60` against canary nodes.
maya: Yes schedule it 30m prior. Ops-bot, add preflight perf test reminder 30m before window.
ops-bot: Reminder created: preflight-perf-test for maintenance mnt-euc3-20260402 at 2026-04-02 00:30 UTC.
oncall-jamie: Communicate to customers: internal comms draft looks good, but add explicit rollback criteria: if model p99 increases >20% or error rate >0.5%, rollback immediately and abort further drains.
maya: Noted. Final checklist: canary start, perf baseline, soft drains, KV warm, staggered reboots, post-check p99/p50/error-rate, customer comm. I'll post playbook link in 15. :white_check_mark:
leo: :thumbsup: I'll ping finance after window if fallback used.
sophie: One more — update Redwood Console alerts to suppress noisy autoscalers during warmup to avoid spin-up noise. Add tag `maintenance:mnt-euc3` to alerts.
raj: OK launching ticket to adjust autoscaler suppression now.
maya: Thanks all. We'll proceed with the window unless anyone raises blockers in the next 2h.
